impact: A clean range resets the AI IPO after Monday's wobble; GOOGL and AMZN stakes get a public mark, and demand will set the tone for AI infrastructure names like NBIS.
summary: Anthropic's amended S-1 sets an indicative range of $70 to $78 for 825M shares, raising up to about $64.4B on Nasdaq under ticker ANT. The top of the range implies up to $1.02T on outstanding shares (Reuters) or $1.405T fully diluted (CNBC), replacing Monday's retracted $70-$80 draft.
title: Anthropic sets IPO range at $70-$78, raising up to $64.4B
